title: 第8220章 令人兴奋的战斗第8219章 决斗开始
content_zh:
结界之内，岩石并不多，与整个空间相比只是一小部分。也即是说，没有那么多岩石能够让陆安一直躲避，他已经连续躲在两个岩石之后，周围已经没有第三个。
正因如此，陆安已经完全暴露。
“我看你还往哪里躲！”
此人大吼咆哮，直奔操控无数道紫光雷鞭，直奔陆安而去！
雷鞭，当真难以数得清！
诸多雷鞭仿佛形成一张巨大的网，迅速将陆安袭来，而且不是要将陆安网住，而是真的每一条雷鞭都向他抽打而来！
看似混乱，这些雷鞭可能会互相撞击，但实际上绝对不会，一切都在此人的掌控之中。
结界之外，所有观战之人都在看这一幕。
这些观战之人大部分都是相元境，大部分实力都比结界内的两人强大，自然能够将一切都看得清楚。
“这下总要动用力量。”
“很好奇，他的力量是什么。”
陆安看着这些雷电袭来，他自然不会动用黑暗，而是直接释放其他能量。
已经进入天神境，并且掌握二十三重世界的他，想用什么力量都可以，能够在能力范围内摆列组合。
至于招术，没有什么固定的招术，一切按照能量的规则来延展，随心所欲。
突然之间，一道红色能量出现！
以陆安为中心，一道红色能量瞬间绽放！
轰！！！
红光犹如烟花，极其绚烂！
见到这红色烟花的瞬间，在场所有人都愣住！因为这真的太像烟花了，谁也没有想到会突然出现一个烟花！
爆炸的烟花直奔所有即将到来的紫光雷鞭而去，两者当即冲击相撞！

一瞬间，所有人都眉头紧凝！
因为他们非常想知道，到底谁更占上风！
毕竟这才是两人的第一次真正交手，就连高飞也死死盯着这一幕，等待接下来的结果。
轰隆隆！！！
双方巨大的招术撞击，结果瞬间显现！
爆炸的红色烟花撞击在紫色雷鞭上，当即将雷鞭切割，分成无数段！
没错！
雷鞭在红光之中，完全被冲击切断，完全被毁！
但……红色烟花也没有形成碾压之势！每一道红色烟花在冲击紫色雷鞭后都会消散，也就是说，双方的力量强度是旗鼓相当的。
爆炸的红色烟花，直接将雷鞭的攻势化解。
对手脸色微变，毕竟雷鞭是直接连接他的身体。雷鞭被如此重创消散，他自然不可能没有影响。
但他依然认为，局势对他有利。
因为烟花爆炸就是爆炸，没有碰撞消散的烟花，也已经向外扩散，在结界中向远处飞去。而他的雷鞭虽然被打成无数段，但依然留在这一片空间之中，存在于陆安的四面八方。就算他无法操控，但这些断裂的雷鞭依然不会迅速消散，算是有一定主场优势。
“扩！”
此人猛地怒吼，双掌猛地张开，瞬间一股强烈的紫光向前而去！
范围性攻击！
单点的攻击力不强，但胜在范围足够大，并且速度够快，直奔陆安席卷！
如此巨大的范围，陆安根本没有躲避的余地。当然按照正常推断来看，这也不需要躲避，只要稍微释放防御即可。
但……陆安没有这么做。
眼看对方释放范围性攻击，他也立刻抬手！

双臂在胸前交叉，跟着瞬间向前拍出！
content_en:
There are not many rocks within the barrier, only a small part compared to the entire space. In other words, there are not that many rocks for Lu An to avoid. He has been hiding behind two rocks in a row, and there is no third one around.
Because of this, Lu An has been completely exposed.
"Let me see where you are going to hide!"
This man roared and roared, controlled countless purple lightning whips, and headed straight for Lu An!
Thunder whips are really hard to count!
Many thunder whips seemed to form a huge net, quickly attacking Lu An, and they were not trying to trap Lu An, but every thunder whip was really hitting him!
Seemingly chaotic, these thunder whips may collide with each other, but in fact they absolutely will not. Everything is under the control of this person.
Outside the barrier, everyone watching the battle was watching this scene.
Most of these people watching the battle are in the Xiangyuan realm, and most of them are stronger than the two people in the barrier, so they can naturally see everything clearly.
"You have to use force this time."
"I'm curious as to what his power is."
Lu An watched these thunder and lightning coming. Naturally, he would not use darkness, but would directly release other energy.
Having entered the realm of gods and mastering the twenty-third world, he can use whatever power he wants and can arrange and combine within the scope of his abilities.
As for moves, there are no fixed moves. Everything is extended according to the rules of energy, and you can do whatever you want.
Suddenly, a burst of red energy appeared!
With Lu An as the center, a red energy bloomed instantly!
boom! ! !
The red light is like fireworks, extremely gorgeous!
The moment they saw the red fireworks, everyone present was stunned! Because it really looked like fireworks, no one expected that a firework would suddenly appear!
The exploding fireworks went straight towards all the incoming purple thunder whips, and the two immediately collided!
For a moment, everyone frowned!
Because they really want to know who has the upper hand!
After all, this is the first real fight between the two, and even Gao Fei is staring at this scene, waiting for the next result.
Boom! ! !
The huge collision of moves between the two sides, the results were revealed instantly!
The exploding red fireworks hit the purple thunder whip and immediately cut it into countless segments!
That's right!
The thunder whip was completely cut off by the impact and completely destroyed in the red light!
But... the red fireworks did not form a crushing force! Every red firework will dissipate after impacting the purple thunder whip, which means that the strength of both sides is evenly matched.
The exploding red fireworks directly neutralized Thunder Whip's offensive.
The opponent's expression changed slightly. After all, the thunder whip was directly connected to his body. The Thunder Whip was so severely damaged and dissipated that it was naturally impossible for him not to be unaffected.
But he still believes that the situation is favorable to him.
Because the explosion of fireworks is an explosion, the fireworks that did not collide and dissipate have spread outward and flew away in the barrier. Although his thunder whip was broken into countless pieces, it still remained in this space and existed in all directions of Lu An. Even if he can't control it, these broken thunder whips will still not dissipate quickly, which can be regarded as a certain home field advantage.
"Expand!"
The man roared violently, opened his palms suddenly, and instantly a strong purple light shot forward!
AoE attack!
The attack power of a single point is not strong, but the range is large enough and the speed is fast enough. It goes straight to Lu An and sweeps it away!
With such a huge scope, Lu An had no room to escape. Of course, according to normal reasoning, there is no need to dodge, just a slight release of defense.
But... Lu An didn't do that.
Seeing the opponent launch a range attack, he immediately raised his hand!
Cross your arms in front of your chest and snap forward instantly!
